title: Ali Ghodsi – The Past, Present, and Future of Big Data – [Founder’s Field Guide, EP.18]

reader_summary.headline: My Guest today is Ali Ghodsi, founder and CEO of Databricks, a data analytics platform for data scientists and developers.
reader_summary.overview: My Guest today is Ali Ghodsi, founder and CEO of Databricks, a data analytics platform for data scientists and developers. He's also the founder of Apache Spark, the open-source project that Databricks is built on, and is an accomplished researcher at UC Berkley's computer science department. Our conversation ranges from the origins of distributed computing to modern data infrastructure, how companies can leverage their massive datasets.

key_points.text: Our conversation ranges from the origins of distributed computing to modern data infrastructure, how companies can leverage their massive datasets.
While technical, it's exactly the kind of conversation I like to have on this show.
I hope you enjoy my conversation with Ali Ghodsi.
